presets.name: Bare
presets.summary: No background, no extras, nothing added.
presets.description: The style with everything switched off: no background, so the avatar sits on whatever your page is, and none of the low-probability extras. The baseline the rest of these presets move away from.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: One warm brown for skin, hair and paper.
presets.description: A real sepia print, which means the skin tone goes with it. Every other preset here leaves skin to the seed; this one cannot, because a color photograph of a face is not sepia. Lips, tongue and throat are warmed to match, so nothing red survives the treatment. One face detail is a pink blush painted into the artwork rather than exposed as a color group, so that variant drops out; the other three follow the ink.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.description: Properly grey rather than grey hair on a colored face. Useful for a print stylesheet, a disabled state, or anywhere color would carry meaning it should not. One face detail is a pink blush painted into the artwork rather than exposed as a color group, so that variant drops out; the other three follow the ink.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: Three steps of one indigo and nothing else.
presets.description: Background, skin and hair take the same hue at three lightnesses, and the mouth follows. As with Sepia, a duotone only works if the face joins in, so the seed loses its say over skin here. One face detail is a pink blush painted into the artwork rather than exposed as a color group, so that variant drops out; the other three follow the ink.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Hair in six dusty tones, skin left to the seed.
presets.description: The style's hair palette runs from black to teal and pink. This replaces it with six dusty tones that sit closer together, so a page full of these reads as one set rather than as a box of crayons.

presets.name: Electric
presets.summary: Hair at full saturation on near black.
presets.description: The other direction, on the same lever: six hair colors past anything the style ships. The background goes dark so they read as lit, and skin still comes from the seed.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.summary: Five soft backgrounds, everything else untouched.
presets.description: Changes nothing about the people, only what they stand in front of. The lightest way to make a set of avatars feel like it belongs together.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: The loud counterpart to Pastel Wall. Strong enough that the avatar holds its own against a busy page, and the only preset here that will fight with a colorful interface rather than sit inside it.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.summary: Near black behind, light hair in front.
presets.description: For dark interfaces. The hair pool drops to the pale end so the silhouette does not disappear into the background. The linework stays black on purpose: pale ink inverts the eyes and dissolves the outline against light hair, which looks like a bug rather than a night mode.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind, everything else untouched.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top, so the light comes from either side across a set.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: Scaled in on the face, for small avatars.
presets.description: Uses scale rather than color. At the size a comment thread gives an avatar, the default framing spends most of it on empty shoulders, and cropping in buys the detail back.
